notes: Version 2.6 aligns the note with ENI 2.11. The central question now distinguishes the group of projection-preserving automorphisms, written 𝒢_Π (ENI Definition 3; the group 𝒢 of Q6a), from the structure group G_Π, which follows Q12's convention and denotes the supplied structure group of a gauge structure in the physical sense; it is not the group acting effectively within 𝒢_Π of ENI Definition 3. The statement that gauge freedom is a direct consequence of non-injectivity is replaced by ENI's exact import: minimal gauge freedom requires non-injectivity (ENI Proposition 4), the converse holds exactly when 𝒢_Π is non-trivial (ENI Remark 4), the global phase rotations of the supplied complex carrier belong to 𝒢_Π to the extent that the projection is defined through span-based observables (Q6a), and gauge structure in the physical sense remains supplied. The vocabulary note and the interpretive outlook carry the same conditions. No result of the note changes.
